summary: All 9 targets promoted to exact records; nothing left zone-level. Three independent per-episode maps (haikyuu.fandom episode infoboxes via MediaWiki API, animefillerguide's cumulative table, and the wiki's separately-maintained PrueShy Anime-to-Chapter blog) agree on every chapter set, corroborated by Wikipedia season summaries and episode-title=chapter-title matches (ep27=ch74, ep28=ch75, ep29=ch79, ep30=ch80 'Yoku', ep56=ch149, ep64=ch211, ep66=ch217, ep67=ch219). Two stored-annotation corrections: (1) the S2E1 pull-forward of chs 76-77 is the Ushijima/Shiratorizawa street encounter (ch 76 ending + ch 77), not a 'Nekoma cold open' — ep26 actually cold-opens on the Seijoh-loss flashback (ch 71); (2) the claimed ch 196 graft in ep64 does not hold up — only PrueShy's blog lists 196, while the fandom episode article (full plot has zero Nekoma/Fukurodani content), Wikipedia's summary, and animefillerguide all give 210-212 only. Ep56's ch-149 re-adapt confirmed as the episode's cold-open flashback (Daichi/Suga/Asahi origin dream). The ep66/67 '216/217 swap' confirmed and sharpened: ch 217 is adapted in full in ep66 while ch 216's Karasuno thread (Date Tech scheduling) and the Atsumu goody-two-shoes resolution are deferred into ep67.

anchors.note: Cold-opens re-covering ch 71 (ep25's endpoint) + 3-on-3 practice; Yachi intro (72); mid/late episode grafts the pulled-forward Ushijima encounter (76 end + 77); closes on 72's exam announcement, so mainline position = 72. All 3 maps: 71,72,76,77.

Opens on the deferred ch 80 (Nekoma set, Lev blocks Hinata), finishes 81, into 82 'Rupture' (the fight). Title 'Greed'(Yoku) = ch 80's title word. Ends mid-82: ep31 'Tempo' re-covers 82 (both maps list 82-84 for ep31).

Cold-opens with a partial re-adapt of ch 149 (Daichi/Suga/Asahi origin dream — episode title = ch 149's title); then finishes 171 (ep55 covered 164-171) and runs 172-174. Ends mid-174: ep57 lists 174-178. ep50->149 stays the S2 endpoint.

HOLE promoted. 210 split with ep63 (ep63 ends at Hinata's ball-boy announcement; ep64 adapts 210's bulk: ball-boy day 1 + youth-camp intros), 211 (Ukai lecture, day 2 — title = ch 211), ends mid-212 at Hinata's 'change my perspective' realization (ch 212's beat); ep65 starts at 212 (stored anchor consistent). NO ch 196 content — see annotation_updates/flags.

Opens on ch 215's closing scene (Tsukishima's invitation; 215 shared with ep65, stored anchor consistent); adapts 216's free-practice/youth-camp material and ALL of 217 (Hyakuzawa arc — title chapter); 216 left unfinished (cliffhanger: Kageyama's goody-two-shoes funk), remainder deferred to ep67 — hence 217 completes before 216 does.

Opens continuing ch 216 (Kageyama funk resolution; 216's Karasuno Date-Tech-scheduling scene lands mid-episode), then 218-220 (camps end, reunion race = 220 'Back Together'; title = ch 219). Ends mid-220: ep68 starts at 220 (stored anchor consistent). Non-monotonic start (216 < ep66's end 217) is the honest reorder value.

annotation_updates.note: Zone chapters confirmed, but the stored reason is wrong: the 76-77 pull-forward in S2E1 is the Ushijima/Shiratorizawa street encounter (ch 76's ending + ch 77), placed in the episode's second half — not a Nekoma cold open. Ep26 cold-opens on the Seijoh-loss flashback (ch 71). Do-not-interpolate guidance stands.

Withdraw the ch 196 graft claim: only the PrueShy wiki blog lists 196 for S4E2; the fandom episode article (full plot contains no Nekoma/Fukurodani/Kenma content), Wikipedia's episode summary, and animefillerguide all give 210-212 only. Remaining zone fact: 210 split with ep63, 212 split with ep65.

Confirmed and sharpened: ch 216 is split across both episodes; ch 217 is adapted in full in ep66 while 216's remainder (Karasuno Date-Tech scheduling, Atsumu goody-two-shoes resolution) airs in ep67 — that deferral is the '216/217 swap'. 215 shared with ep65; 220 shared with ep68.
